query: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'incidents',(SELECT count(*) FROM ops.source_incidents WHERE status='OPEN'), 'myTasks',(SELECT count(*) FROM ops.tasks WHERE assignee_user_id=$1 AND status<>'DONE'), 'overdueTasks',(SELECT count(*) FROM ops.tasks WHERE due_at<clock_timestamp() AND status<>'DONE'), 'reviewQueue',(SELECT count(*) FROM editorial.review_assignments WHERE status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS')), 'failedJobs',(SELECT count(*) FROM ops.jobs WHERE status IN ('FAILED','DEAD_LETTER')), 'unreadNotifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM ops.notifications WHERE user_id=$1 AND read_at IS NULL))
